subject: Request: schedule alignment and credit-term exception for Zenora Therapeutics
messages:
From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@zenora.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Thorne <ben.thorne@zenora.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: invoicing cadence + payment terms for PO 9231

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Procurement at Zenora has one operational request before we can finalize the PO: our finance team runs quarterly remits and our treasury prefers Net-90 payment on vendor invoices to align with internal budget cycles. Can Redwood do quarterly invoicing with Net-90 on an annual contract? The PO (attached) is for the first-year subscription (~$720,000 ARR).

If Net-90 is a hard no, can we discuss mitigations (e.g., partial prepayment, ACH setup, or short-term credit terms)? Procurement needs the invoice cadence and terms documented for our legal/treasury.

Attached: Zenora_PO_9231.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Cheng
Head of Procurement
Zenora Therapeutics

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: invoicing cadence + payment terms for PO 9231

Team — forwarding a procurement ask from Zenora. They want quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for an annual subscription (see PO). Large ARR and strategic in our healthcare vertical. Ask: can we support Net-90 + quarterly invoices? If we do, what mitigation do you need (prepay %, contract amendment, credit check, escrow)?

My recommendation: consider conditional approval if we obtain either (A) 25% prepayment on signature AND ACH setup, or (B) Net-60 instead of Net-90 with standard quarterly invoicing and a 5% concession. If Finance signs off on Net-90 with 25% prepay + DocuSign amendment, I’m comfortable moving forward and offering a one-time 8% strategic discount.

Note: contract start date July 31; they want to align invoices to their quarter dates. Deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2000234/rdw-2026-887

- Nikhil
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:42:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: invoicing cadence + payment terms for PO 9231

Nikhil — reviewed with Treasury Ops. High level: Zenora is mid-market, no public defaults on our records, ARR is material. Finance is generally uncomfortable with Net-90 without stronger safeguards. If Sales wants to accommodate, we need the following in writing before any exception is recorded:

- 25% prepayment at contract signature (applied to first invoice)
- ACH mandate + vendor bank verification (Treasury to be CC'd on setup)
- DocuSign amendment that explicitly calls out quarterly invoicing cadence and payment milestone dates
- A standard credit hold clause: if payment is more than 45 days late, Redwood may suspend provisioning after a 10-day cure notice

Attached is a short risk matrix (risk_matrix.xlsx) with our recommended approval guardrails. If Markus gives exec approval, Finance will process the amendment template and route to DocuSign. Without prepay or ACH mandate, we should push for Net-60 + 5% one-time concession instead.

-Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: invoicing cadence + payment terms for PO 9231 — conditional exec approval

Thanks — reviewed. Conditional approval granted for quarterly invoicing with Net-90 under these non-negotiable conditions:

1) 25% prepayment due on signature (applied to Q1 invoice).
2) ACH mandate + successful vendor bank verification prior to first invoice dispatch.
3) Signed DocuSign amendment executed before provisioning starts (link to draft below).
4) A credit hold suspension clause (as Lauren outlined) is included in the amendment.

If any of the above are not satisfied within 14 calendar days of signature, Finance will switch the account to Net-60 and remove the one-time strategic discount. Sales: confirm you accept these guardrails and inform the customer. Legal to sign off on the amendment text; Finance will prepare DocuSign envelope once Sales confirms.

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.net/Zenora-amendment-12345
Approval granted by: Markus Klein
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@zenora.com>, Ben Thorne <ben.thorne@zenora.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: invoicing cadence + payment terms for PO 9231 — next steps and conditional terms

Hi Alyssa / Ben — thanks for the patience. Good news: Redwood Finance has approved a quarterly invoicing cadence with Net-90 payment terms for Zenora, subject to a few conditions we need to complete before go-live:

1) 25% prepayment on signature (applied to first quarter invoice).
2) ACH mandate + bank verification (Treasury contact to provide routing/account details).
3) Execute the attached DocuSign amendment before provisioning (link below).
4) Contract will include a credit-hold clause: if an invoice is >45 days overdue, Redwood may suspend service after a 10-day cure notice.

Once you confirm acceptance of these conditions, I’ll instruct Legal/Finance to send the DocuSign envelope and we’ll schedule provisioning the week after signature. We can also proceed with the one-time 8% strategic discount on Year 1 provided the conditions are met within 14 days of signature.

Attachments: Zenora_PO_9231.pdf, DocuSign_Amendment_zenora.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/Zenora-amendment-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2000234/rdw-2026-887

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
